description: Allocation pressure with objects present: one statement inserts 400 rows of about 790 bytes into Dense (several dozen new data pages and ownership/allocation growth). Asks what happens to the catalog's pages and to every other table's pages. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes one mutation and closes it. The full catalog view is taken before the steps and after them (each a read-only open, with its own file state).
retentionNote: Designed r-fmt-2-pres-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
